rationale: The workflow already incorporates the applicable optimizations supported by the evidence: dependency caching is present via bundler-cache: true and an explicit actions/cache for vendor/smoke-bundle (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE); a 30-minute job timeout is already set on the smoke job (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT); pull_request triggers are already path-filtered to relevant directories (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is not suitable because the smoke job's purpose is comprehensive coverage across generated project combinations, and every matrix outcome appears required for diagnostics; required_checks status is not_verified, so changing cancellation semantics is unsafe. P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE is contraindicated because the nightly schedule exists to catch gem releases that break generated projects, which is a time-based external dependency need. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE would require adding run-cancellation logic and its evidence is simulation-based; with required checks unverified, altering run identity/cancellation is not supported. No other pattern prerequisites are clearly met by the repository context.
